# Tux Paint

> Free, open-source drawing software designed for children of all ages, featuring intuitive tools, parental controls, and cross-platform support.

Tux Paint is a kid-friendly art application available on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and Chromebooks. Led by developer Bill Kendrick, the project emphasizes accessibility, educational value, and community contribution through stamps, translations, and user-generated artwork.

## Key Topics

- Tux Paint
- Open-source drawing software
- Educational tool for kids
- Cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, Chromebooks)
- Free drawing software
- Tux Paint Stamps
- Tux Paint Config
- PNG and SVG support
- Parental controls
- Bill Kendrick
- GNU General Public License
- Installation and system requirements
- Community gallery
- Bug reports and troubleshooting
- Localization and translations
